descriptionChirho: Proper name meaning 'Yah has helped,' used for multiple individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most prominently: (1) Azariah the high priest who confronted King Uzziah for burning incense (2 Chr 26:17-20); (2) Azariah as the birth name of King Uzziah of Judah (2 Kgs 14:21, 15:1-8); (3) several Azariahs in Chronicler genealogies (1 Chr 2:8, 2:38, 3:12, 6:9-14, 6:36, 9:11). Appears in two orthographic forms: longer Azaryahu and shorter Azaryah. Transliterated consistently: Arabic Azarya, German Asarja, French Azaria, Spanish Azarias, Korean Asarya, Hindi Ajaryah. All auto-clusters (Azaryah, and Azaryah, and Azaryahu, of Azaryah, and Azariah) represent syntactic variants (conjunction, preposition) of the same proper name across its various referents, not different lexical senses.
